text: いっしょう　のびつづけるので　かたい　モノを　かじって　けずる。

structure.jp: いっしょう　のびつづけるので
structure.en: because they keep growing all its life

structure.jp: かたい　モノを　かじって
structure.en: it gnaws on hard things and

patterns.name: 〜つづける
patterns.explanation: つづける stuck onto a verb means 'keep doing' it. のびつづける = 'keep growing'.

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので gives the reason for what comes next. のびつづけるので = 'because they keep growing'.

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: Here the て-form shows the way the next action gets done. かじって　けずる = 'wears them down by gnawing'.
